arbitrary.text: The requirement to install the lining before it could trap particles felt somewhat arbitrary, although the feedback made the next action clear.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter: the sequence made the relationship between the airway and lung defenses clear, and I would be curious to see how another body system connects.
